services_hero_desc: VIKI Construction Corporation provides comprehensive solutions in civil and industrial construction, design consulting, and high-tech livestock farm development.
sec1_quote: Initiating new journeys with international-standard construction quality.
sec1_p1: VIKI operates strongly in key sectors including large-scale industrial factory construction, export processing zone infrastructure, high-tech civil works, and modern closed livestock farm systems.

sec1_card_desc: Engineers directly surveying and constructing projects

cv1_desc: Reputation is the vital foundation of VIKI's growth. We uphold all commitments regarding quality, schedule, and safety for clients and partners.
cv2_desc: Quality is our core competitive edge. Strictly applying modern technical standards and precise procedures to deliver optimal long-term durability.
cv3_desc: Enthusiastic, bold, and proactive. Our young, creative personnel team is an invaluable asset driving breakthrough corporate successes.

lead_p1: VIKI Construction Corporation operates primarily in civil & industrial construction, industrial design, and project investment formulation. We constantly listen and strive to enhance service quality and management for client satisfaction.
lead_p2: Though a young enterprise, VIKI is steadily asserting its stance thanks to sustainable development and strict compliance with business standards. Our motto "Reputation – Quality – Youthfulness" remains our compass.
lead_p3: We look forward to receiving continuous trust and partnership from valued partners and clients on the road to Success.
ms1_desc: VIKI Construction was established during economic fluctuations. Driven to turn challenges into opportunities, the company was born to dedicate youth to national growth.
ms2_desc: Successfully constructing large-scale projects for global corporations such as KSP Hai Duong, AAC Vinh Phuc, AAC Bac Giang, Vinh Tan Binh Duong Farm, and CP Binh Dinh.
ms3_desc: Awarded the contract for BFF Factory & Warehouse (242.5 Billion VND) and high-tech industrial packages, working towards entering TOP 100 Vietnam Construction Companies.

team_cap2_desc: Young workforce thoroughly trained from theory to site practice, constantly upgrading skills.
team_cap3_desc: VIKI employs a large team of full-time architects and engineers stationed in offices and directing on-site operations.

cap_c2_desc: Mastering fabrication and erection of large-span steel structures, cladding, and heavy industrial anti-corrosion solutions.
